The '''Gavos Droid Revolution''' was an uprising of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on [[Gavos]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was planned by [[EV-8D3]], an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] and figurehead of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], in order to spread a [[Droid supremacy|violent rebellion]] against [[Species/Legends|organic]] life forms throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The revolution was put down by a group of spacers hired by [[Bargos (Hutt)|Bargos]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
